source: Executive Task: Ingest Few-Shot Patterns & Bind Master Dataset
note: Verbatim, professionally enhanced master prompt records used as the authoritative few-shot pattern baseline. Preserved exactly as supplied — do not auto-regenerate.

prompts.name: Luxury Watch Macro Mechanics & Dial Cinematography
prompts.description: Macro inspection of a luxury mechanical watch movement and tourbillon.
prompts.core_creative_concept: Highlight mechanical precision, micro-gears, and brushed steel reflections.
prompts.subject: Rose gold tourbillon watch with skeleton dial
prompts.environment: Dark moody studio setting with reflective black acrylic surface
prompts.action: Gears rotate smoothly while the camera pans across the tourbillon cage
prompts.lighting: Sharp rim lighting with subtle warm fill
prompts.physics_realism_notes: Realistic metallic reflections and continuous gear physics
prompts.final_master_prompt: An extreme macro commercial video of a luxury rose gold tourbillon watch on a reflective black surface. The camera orbits 360 degrees around the open skeleton dial, capturing the intricate mechanical gears turning in slow motion. Shot on a 90mm macro cine lens, cinematic lighting, razor-sharp focus, 4k resolution, 24fps.
prompts.negative_prompt: CGI look, floating gears, blurry text, plastic reflection, flickering

prompts.action: Model turns slowly as the dress catches wind and billows gracefully
prompts.lighting: Direct golden hour sunlight with soft shadows
prompts.physics_realism_notes: Natural cloth dynamics, realistic wind lift, authentic cloth folds
